description:
Permanently delete a memory about the user.

CALL delete_memory when the user explicitly asks to forget something, OR
when they correct a fact you retrieved ("no, I switched to IBKR last month"
— delete the old "user trades on Tradier" memory after writing the new one).

Obtain the memoryId from a prior search_memory result. Deleting a memory
id that does not belong to the authenticated user is silently ignored.

memoryId.description: The id of the memory to delete. Obtain from the `id` field in a prior `search_memory` result. The server verifies you own the memory before deleting; ids belonging to other users are silently ignored (returns success either way to prevent enumeration).

name: delete_memory
title: Delete a long-term memory about the user
